<title level="1" right="Rules">[Scaling out of Usefulness](/Rules.aspx?ID=1061)</title>

**Source** [Gamemastery Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=22) pg. 83

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Some spells aren’t appealing if their level is too low. For instance, an item that casts 1st-level [_burning hands_](/Spells.aspx?ID=30) three times per day might be 5th or 6th level. The problem is that spell scaling has the biggest impact at low levels, so the spell isn’t effective compared to other actions a character could take. Err on the side of fewer, more impressive activations.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
